---
title: "ssoossh ssh"
description: "Manage interactive SSH certificates."
---

<!-- Generated by genclidocs from the cobra command tree in client/cmd. Do not edit. -->

Certificates for people. `login` gets one (or reuses a valid one), `logout` removes it, `inspect` shows what is loaded, `proxycommand` gets one and then hands the connection to a relay, and `config` prints the ssh_config lines that make ssh run all this for you. Start with `ssoossh ssh config`.

## Synopsis

```
ssoossh ssh [command]
```

## Global options

Inherited from [`ssoossh`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoossh/) and its parents.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-c`, `--config` | string |  | path to an extra config file, merged after the standard locations |
| `--server` | string |  | server address, e.g. https://ssh.example.com; https is assumed when no scheme is given |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | count | `0` | trace what the command is doing, to stderr; repeat for more (-v steps, -vv requests and files, -vvv bodies) |

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`ssoossh ssh config`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoossh/ssh-config/) | Print the ssh_config lines that hook ssoossh into your existing ssh. |
| [`ssoossh ssh inspect`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoossh/ssh-inspect/) | Print details of the currently held ssoossh certificate(s). |
| [`ssoossh ssh login`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoossh/ssh-login/) | Sign in through the browser and load a signed SSH certificate into the agent (or files). |
| [`ssoossh ssh logout`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoossh/ssh-logout/) | Remove ssoossh-managed keys and certificates from the agent (or files). |
| [`ssoossh ssh proxycommand`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoossh/ssh-proxycommand/) | Ensure a valid certificate, then hand the connection to a relay command such as nc. |
